mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, role, real_name, district_scope, hospital_scope) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{role}, #{realName}, #{districtScope}, #{hospitalScope})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, role = #{role}, real_name = #{realName}, district_scope = #{districtScope}, hospital_scope = #{hospitalScope} WHERE id = #{id}
